advancements.sigilstead.root.title: Sigilstead
advancements.sigilstead.root.description: Explore, fight and build. Sigils drop from doing those things, and everything here is bought with them — storage, farms, and hearts. Nothing here is built from redstone.
advancements.sigilstead.sigil.title: Something Worth Keeping
advancements.sigilstead.sigil.descriptio: Find a Sigil. They come from chests, bosses and the occasional mob — never from a farm. This one item feeds all three of Sigilstead's systems, so what you spend it on is the whole choice.
advancements.sigilstead.core_sigil.title: The Cheapest of the Three
advancements.sigilstead.core_sigil.descr: Craft a Core Sigil. It is the cheapest thing a Sigil becomes, on purpose: replacing a farm should be the first thing you can afford.
advancements.sigilstead.heart_sigil.desc: Craft a Heart Sigil. Use it and you keep the heart — until you die, which costs one.
advancements.sigilstead.vault_sigil.desc: Craft a Vault Sigil. The Vault itself is free — this is what makes it bigger, makes it reach further, and puts it back if you move the Anchor. It is the most expensive of the three.
advancements.sigilstead.three_ways.title: Three Ways to Spend It
advancements.sigilstead.three_ways.descr: Hold a Core Sigil, a Heart Sigil and a Vault Sigil at the same time. Every Sigil you find is one of these three and not the other two — that tension is the point.
advancements.sigilstead.vault_anchor.des: Craft a Vault Anchor. One per world, and it holds everything the Vault is: its contents, its size and how far it reaches. It costs no Sigil and the first activation is free — place it where your base is going to stay.
Activate the Anchor. The first one a world ever has is free; replacing it later costs a Vault Sigil, which is what stops the Vault being something you carry around.
advancements.sigilstead.satchel.title: Send It Home
advancements.sigilstead.satchel.descript: Craft a Satchel. It deposits into the Vault from anywhere, in any dimension, for free — no more walking home because your inventory filled up. It cannot take anything back out.
Put something in the Vault. Deposit is the safe verb: unlimited range, no cost, granted the moment you have a Satchel.
advancements.sigilstead.vault_pouch.desc: Craft a Vault Pouch. It adds withdrawal — the powerful half — with search and sort. Spending a Vault Sigil on your own Pouch is one not spent on the world's Vault.
advancements.sigilstead.vault_withdrew.d: Take something out of the Vault remotely. This is the verb the ladder sells, and it only works where the Anchor's reach covers you.
advancements.sigilstead.vault_capacity.d: Spend a Vault Sigil on capacity at the Anchor. There is no ceiling on this one — it keeps taking Sigils for as long as you keep finding them.
Buy Overworld reach with a Sigil crafted against an Echo Shard. The proof item is the gate: you cannot buy reach into somewhere you have never been.
advancements.sigilstead.reach_nether.des: Buy Nether reach. Reach tiers are per-dimension and not cumulative — each one names the place it unlocks.
advancements.sigilstead.reach_end.title: The Long Reach
advancements.sigilstead.reach_end.descri: Buy End reach with a Sigil crafted against Dragon's Breath. Your whole storage, anywhere you can stand.
advancements.sigilstead.linked_funnel.de: Craft a Linked Funnel. Hopper-speed, straight into the Vault from any farm anywhere — or one filtered item back out, if the reach covers where it stands.
advancements.sigilstead.primed_core.titl: A Core With Nothing In It
advancements.sigilstead.primed_core.desc: Craft a Primed Core. It does nothing yet. Carry it while you do the thing you want it to replace, and it learns that thing.
advancements.sigilstead.classic_core.des: Craft one of the eleven classic cores — guardian, wither skull, ender, shulker, raid, barter and the rest. Each replaces a farm that used to need a schematic.
advancements.sigilstead.core_attuned.des: Finish attuning a core. Mine the block, farm the crop or fight the mob enough times while carrying it, and it becomes a finished Core locked to exactly that.
advancements.sigilstead.core_housing.des: Craft a housing. Each family has its own — Planter, Paddock, Quarry Node, Soul Cage — and the housing decides which cores it will take.
advancements.sigilstead.core_socketed.de: Socket an attuned core. It produces whether or not you are there, whether or not the chunk is loaded — and one core per target per world, so there is nothing to scale by building more.
advancements.sigilstead.core_yield.title: Income
advancements.sigilstead.core_yield.descr: Collect what a core made. Point a Linked Funnel at the housing and you never have to again.
advancements.sigilstead.core_tier_iii.de: Run a tier III core. Tiering is the only way to make a core faster — six times the base rate, and the entire scaling curve the pack has.
advancements.sigilstead.codex.title: Written Down
advancements.sigilstead.codex.descriptio: Craft a Codex. It costs no Sigil — enchanting is the one system the currency does not gate. Feed it a book and it remembers the enchantment forever.
advancements.sigilstead.codex_archived.d: Archive an enchantment. Your archive follows you, not the block, so any Codex anywhere shows you the same library.
advancements.sigilstead.tome.title: Take a Copy
advancements.sigilstead.tome.description: Seal a Tome against something in your archive. That is a copy of an enchantment you already own, on demand, at a fixed price.
Teach a librarian from a Sealed Tome. The trade sticks — through level-ups, restocks and reloads — so a librarian you taught stays taught.
advancements.sigilstead.abundance.title: Abundance
advancements.sigilstead.abundance.descri: Find the Abundance treasure enchantment. It multiplies what a block drops, and it is one of the two enchantments the pack adds.
advancements.sigilstead.kiln_touch.title: Kiln Touch
advancements.sigilstead.kiln_touch.descr: Find Kiln Touch. Blocks come out of the ground already smelted — no furnace, no fuel.
advancements.sigilstead.heart_gained.des: Use a Heart Sigil and keep the heart. Dying costs you one back, down to a floor of five, so hearts are something you hold rather than something you own.
advancements.sigilstead.heart_max.title: Twenty Hearts
advancements.sigilstead.heart_max.descri: Reach the cap: twenty hearts, ten of them bought a Sigil at a time.
